title: Michael Allred
description: "To kill time one summer, me and my brother, Curtis, walked into STAR WARS late," admits Michael Allred. "Whew! I was immediately sucked into that world and it's been a major influence ever since." For his GALAXY illustration, Allred chose to depict Luke with his hot-blooded Tatooine pals, Biggs and Camie. The artist made his comics debut in the early '90's with DEAD AIR (Slave Labor). Other creations include GRAPHIQUE MUSIQUE, THE GEEK and SANDMAN from DC and his popular new MADMAN ADVENTURES now from Dark Horse.
